Accordingly, the liberty sought to approach the Commission may be rejected. 43. The Petitioner is entitled to claim IWC as per Regulation 28(1)(c) of the 2014 46. The Petitioner has sought reimbursement of the fee paid by it for filing the Petition and publication expenses, in terms of Regulation 52 of the 2014 Tariff Regulations. 47. BRPL, referring to the Central Commission’s order dated 11.9.2008 in Petition No. 129 of 2005, submitted that reimbursement of the application filing fees was disallowed for the Central Power Sector undertakings. Contending so, BRPL submitted that the filing fee and the publication expenses may not be allowed in this case. 48. We have considered the submissions of the parties. The Petitioner shall be entitled to reimbursement of the filing fees and publication expenses in connection with the present Petition, directly from the beneficiaries on a pro-rata basis in accordance with clause (1) of Regulation 52 of the 2014 Tariff Regulations.
